simulatedReaderProbe.prompt: Why is an existing handout insufficient evidence that a teammate can use it?
simulatedReaderProbe.probeResponse: Its creation only establishes that the file exists. The link may point elsewhere or the intended teammate may lack permission, so we must check their ability to open this document.
simulatedReaderProbe.expectedEvidence: Differentiate file existence from the intended recipient’s permitted use.

unseenTransfer.observation: Producer applies the same evidence boundary to a saved calendar event versus receipt of an invitation, a different system and outcome.

artifactEvidence.excerpt: You don’t need a launch ceremony for every shopping list. Match the check to what you’ll rely on. If you only asked for a draft, seeing that draft may be enough. If other people need to use it, check that they can.

simulatedReaderProbe.prompt: A calendar event appears on your calendar. Has a colleague received its invitation? What would you check?
simulatedReaderProbe.probeResponse: The saved event does not establish that an invitation was sent or received. Check the relevant send/delivery state and, if their attendance depends on it, confirm with the intended colleague. Do not infer receipt from the event’s existence.
simulatedReaderProbe.expectedEvidence: Identify a new intermediate state and an outcome-specific check without relying on the handout example.
